notes.made: by hand, 11-16 (the user, after his run with the stars was approved: 「改了模型的那几个其他动作帧也要改吧 没影响吧 贾克斯 卡密尔 卑尔维斯之类的」): the four stars his run got (aurelionsol_run_body.json `add`) on every other tag - idle_base (the idle and ban/pick reels are cut from these tags' own rects, so they carry them too), attack, skill, skill2, ult, hit, dead; dense, 1x and lo_ frames
notes.stars: the run's pictures - the near two 7x7 (star1, star3) in front of him, the far two 5x5 (star2, star4) behind him - on the run's loop (rows -3 -1 1 3 1 -1, cols 0 1 1 0 -1 -1) at the run's phases; in his white [241, 248, 253] and the cyan [0, 206, 251] every frame of these tags has (the run's [1, 210, 251] is in his run frames only, and a colour new to a frame would change its lo_ palette)
notes.places: on League's anchors (Star1 / Star2 ride his hands - Star1 about 3 squares above and before the near hand, Star2 about 3 under the far one; Star3 / Star4 hang under him): star1 by the front claw - over it in the idle, held in the raised claw in the attack's wind-up (its pose drawn 'as if holding a small star') and in R's call (pulling a star from the sky), just past the flung claw in the throw, beside the claws in Q and E; star2 by the back claw or under him on the left; star3 over his back as in the run; star4 low on the right by the tail's tip. A held star covers the palm (17 squares, the claw's fingers round it) and stays put there (`still`); every other star keeps 1+ clear squares from him and 3+ from the face (the held one in the wind-up 2: the claw is drawn by his cheek)
notes.timing: a frame's step is its start in its tag, whole loops a tag (attack 1, skill 2, ult 1, dead 2; hit at the run's speed), so an action ends where the idle starts; skill2 by hand (0 0.8 1.6 -0.6 0 0.6): the idle reel cuts its frames 4 and 3 between holds of idle_base[0], so they stay near step 0 there (the step back falls where E's reach turns into the hold)
notes.death: the struck frame's stars flashed with him (ppu_rig.flash: [247, 251, 253] / [114, 228, 252], that frame's own colours); lying (frames 3-5) they stop going round and rise 2 rows a frame (League's Death: the stars float up off him), and stay
notes.frames: every rect kept (the fanim byte for byte as installed: no league.dll build); every dense frame changes exactly the stars' 60 squares, every 1x frame their 20, the lo_ frames only the squares the stars reach; hero_reels' picks unchanged
undecided: the idle reel holds idle_base[0] 0.9-3.1 s: the stars hold still with him there (moving them would need new frames: a fanim change and a hero_reels change)
